REGISTRATION_ACCESS_KEY.description: A private random value of at least 32 characters used only to create one-use device links. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and enter it on your Worker's link page; it is never placed in the QR code.

CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: A separate private random value of at least 32 characters used to encrypt provider credentials before storing them in D1. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and never enter it in the app.
